2608.25926.title: Formal, Executable and Explainable Runtime Monitoring of Spoken Air Traffic Control Operational Procedures
2608.25926.paper_summary: Air traffic control procedures are executed through spoken exchanges between controllers and pilots. These interactions are essential to the safety of air transportation: failures in their execution can create severe operational hazards, as evidenced by past fatal accidents. Assessing whether an instruction has been followed requires relating what was said to the aircraft concerned, its state, and the obligations that pilots must meet. We present a runtime verification framework that monitors such procedures by checking controller-pilot exchanges, surveillance data, and onboard observations. The framework parses radio communications into events linked to the entities they concern and merges them with surveillance and onboard observations into a time-stamped trace. The ICAO-derived obligations as formalized as temporal formulas with explicit time bounds and evaluated over execution traces. Every violation is reported along with the breached obligations and the observations that support the verdict. With real traffic, the complete pipeline reaches an F1 of 0.85 against blind human-annotated violations; in 1,495 synthetic situations derived from two public corpora, the monitor logic returns the expected verdict in every case. In two historical accidents reconstructed from official investigation reports, the monitor identifies the same procedural deviations documented by the investigators.
2608.25926.paper_summary_zh: 空中交通管制程序是透過控制人員與飛行員之間的口頭交流來執行的。這些互動對於航空運輸的安全至關重要：其執行失敗可能會造成嚴重的操作危險，這在過去的致命事故中已經得到了證明。評估指令是否被遵循需要將所說的內容與相關的飛機、其狀態以及飛行員必須遵守的義務聯繫起來。我們提出了一個運行時驗證框架，通過檢查控制人員與飛行員的交流、監視數據和機上觀察來監控這些程序。該框架將無線電通信解析為與其相關的實體鏈接的事件，並將這些事件與監視和機上觀察合併成一個帶有時間戳的追蹤記錄。根據ICAO衍生的義務，這些義務被形式化為具有明確時間界限的時間公式，並在執行追蹤記錄上進行評估。每次違規都會報告並附上違反的義務以及支持該判決的觀察結果。在真實交通情況下，完整的管道在盲目人類標註的違規情況下達到0.85的F1；在從兩個公共語料庫衍生的1,495個合成情況中，監控邏輯在每種情況下都返回預期的判決。在從官方調查報告重建的兩起歷史事故中，監控器識別出調查人員記錄的相同程序偏差。
